description:
Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-8037: Progress LoadMaster contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an un-authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the LoadMaster appliance by exploiting unsanitized input in multiple command endpoints.. Product: LoadMaster

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_general_014", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%cve%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%2026%') AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%CVE-%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%exploit%') AND "value" > 0
